FN-NRH5MJT-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 89
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/18/2025
Senate Bill 89 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections
(DOC) by an undetermined amount to search for and serve arrest warrants on inmates in DOC
custody and to provide access to inmates to attend pre-trial hearings virtually.

FN-NRH5MJT-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 89
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/01/2025
Senate Bill 89 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary would increase the obligations of the
Department of Corrections (DOC) by an undetermined amount to: 1) search for and serve arrest
warrants on inmates in DOC custody, under certain conditions; 2) provide notification to issuing
entities; and 3) to provide access to inmates to attend pre-trial hearings virtually, under certain
conditions.
